messages.author: 1da6fba54b1166e9
messages.subject: Reporting other frequency data
parts:
Dear team,

Is there a function to report the average, maximum and minimum Major Allele Frequency, One Ratio Reference Allele and One Ratio Reference SNP Allele?

Best,

Juliana

messages.author: 9e12eec50c435b60
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Reporting other frequency data
parts:
I think what you are after is gl.report.locmetric(gl,metric="OneRatioSnp"). There is a corresponding filter gl.filter.locmetric() that you might also like to use.

A
